'''2016 European Championship Day 3 Jon Benkert Holtet DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jon Benkert Holtet]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jon Benkert Holtet]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 3
